references.qualities: Owner reported that the dark feed was hard to read and colours lacked distinction. Capture shows its previous link and article hierarchy.
Sets the shared shell control spacing and hierarchy around the reading pane.

craft.evidence: Solid story surfaces, a compact no-metadata link, and distinct preview panels give each group an even inset. The external-link arrow stays attached at 320px with 125% text.

coherence.evidence: The shared dashboard tabs retain the size and spacing of adjacent controls. Muted light surfaces and ink distinguish the reading pane while links and selected controls use one blue accent.

hierarchy.evidence: Headline, summary, then official source read first. Related posts sit below the source, with snippets and activity visually separated inside each post.

stateMotion.evidence: Selected filters and the keyboard focus outline are distinct. Saved edition and Retry stay usable at 320px with 125% text.

actualSize.evidence: Checked 1440px and 320px in Firefox and reviewed compact, normal, large-text, and saved-edition views. The widest text wraps across eight aligned lines at 320px with 125% text.

rejectionRegression.evidence: HELM-AI-001: measured text contrast ranged from 8.00:1 for discussion links to 16.12:1 for headlines. Preview text measured 11.17:1 and activity 8.59:1. The 320px saved card clears the story by 16px.

rejectionsAddressed.evidence: At 320px with 125% text, Retry has 15/15/13/11px glyph clearance on left/top/right/bottom. Coding tools has 15/13/14/11px clearance.
At 320px with 125% text, the saved notice clears the next story by 16px and the message glyphs clear Retry by 15px. Links stay in their own boxes.
